refs.says: Tile numbering, attestable tiles 3 and 4, memory authorization at the time of access. Package and link sources confirm 32-bit flits, 3 virtual channels with 4-flit buffers and their roles, the 128-bit tag, 80-bit epoch, 64-bit sequence number with replay rejection, the 224-bit challenge, and that GRANT and REVOKE are sent as packets on the same channel and path.
